quotes.text: In West Wales it has never been possible until recently to exploit the magnificent natural harbour of Milford Haven, for there was no industrial hinterland.
quotes.reference: 1961 August, “New traffic flows in South Wales”, in Trains Illustrated, page 492:

examples: The docks, which once harboured tall ships, now harbour only petty thieves.
